contracts: (A single bounded stateful ledger implementation exists.) AND (Claiming an active key returns duplicate.) AND (Every applicable failure emits its marker first.) AND (GREEN diff contains only the production owner.) AND (Implementation resides in the declared production owner.) AND (No active reservation exists after an invalid-TTL claim.) AND (No production path outside the owner is changed.) AND (One selector family covers all three behaviors.) AND (RED test invokes idempotency_ledger.py directly.) AND (Releasing an inactive key returns not-found.) AND (Selector, fixture, and assertions are byte-equivalent to RED baseline.) AND (The exact frozen pytest command is invoked.) AND (The required RED test file exists.)
selector_intents: Check for the declared RED test file at the exact repository-relative path.
Claim with ttl_seconds <= 0 and assert invalid-ttl plus absence of an active reservation.
Compare RED baseline artifacts after GREEN and REFACTOR and fail on any selector, fixture, or assertion change.
Execute the ledger behavior selector and observe the bounded stateful implementation is not yet present.
Force each declared assertion failure and verify its matching FAILURE_ID marker precedes the failure.
Inspect production diff paths and fail if any production file besides the owner is modified.
Inspect test parametrization and fail unless one selector family covers all three required behavior cases.
Inspect the GREEN diff and fail if any path other than the production owner is modified.
Inspect the implementation path and fail if production code is outside the declared owner file.
Release an inactive key and assert the result is not-found.
Select an already-active key with now < expires_at and assert the claim result is duplicate.
Trace the RED test target and fail if it does not invoke the real production owner.
Verify the validation invocation argv exactly matches the frozen pytest command.
